name: M'ONDUNIQ M'andelic PREP FOAM – skin preparation foam
shortDescription: Skin preparation foam with mandelic acid, PHA acids and niacinamide. Before Carbon Peeling, cold plasma, Biopen Nano and microneedling RF treatments – also for daily home care. 150 ml.
description:
M'ONDUNIQ PREP FOAM is a professional skin preparation foam developed specifically to support the effectiveness of aesthetic treatments. Its innovative formula contains mandelic acid, lactobionic acid, gluconolactone, niacinamide, the SyriCalm soothing complex and Aloe Vera extract, which work together to cleanse the skin, regulate sebum production, gently remove dead skin cells and prepare the skin for professional treatments.

The effectiveness of aesthetic treatments depends greatly on skin preparation. Excess sebum, accumulated dead skin cells and impurities can hinder the optimal performance of treatments and the absorption of professional active ingredients. PREP FOAM prepares the skin gently yet highly effectively, making it an ideal choice before Carbon Peeling, cold plasma, Biopen Nano and other professional treatments.

Its light, silky foam does not dry out the skin, while resulting in a fresher, clearer and more even complexion.

features.title: Why use it?
features.description:
Sebum, impurities and dead skin cells accumulate on the skin surface day after day. In many cases they are not even visible to the naked eye, yet they can significantly affect the effectiveness of professional treatments.

PREP FOAM helps:

remove excess sebum
gently dissolve dead skin cells
keep pores clear
optimise the skin surface before treatments
support more even absorption of active ingredients
improve skin texture and radiance
preserve the skin's hydration and comfort
features.highlight: Its light, silky foam does not dry out the skin, while resulting in a fresher, clearer and more even complexion.

features.title: Why is it essential before professional treatments?
features.description:
Before Carbon Peeling

During a Carbon Peeling treatment, it is especially important that the carbon mask adheres evenly to the skin surface. PREP FOAM removes excess sebum and surface impurities, contributing to a more even distribution of the carbon and the optimal performance of the treatment.

Before cold plasma treatments

Cold plasma acts directly on the skin surface. A cleansed skin surface free of sebum and impurities contributes to more even energy delivery and a higher standard of professional treatment.

Before the Biopen Nano module

With the Nano module, the goal is to deliver professional active ingredients as evenly as possible into the surface layers of the skin. PREP FOAM prepares the skin and removes dead skin cells, thereby supporting the effectiveness of the treatments.

Before microneedling RF treatments

For oily, combination and problematic skin, it can be used as a professional skin preparation product based on the skin diagnosis of the specialist performing the treatment. It helps remove excess sebum and prepares the skin for the treatment.

functionCards.name: Mandelic acid (Mandelic Acid)
functionCards.description: A gentle AHA acid that helps remove dead skin cells, refines skin texture, supports clearer pores and results in a more radiant complexion.

functionCards.name: Lactobionic acid
functionCards.description: A modern PHA acid that, in addition to its gentle exfoliating and antioxidant properties, helps preserve the skin's hydration and supports its natural renewal.

functionCards.name: Gluconolactone
functionCards.description: A gentle PHA acid that improves the evenness of the skin surface while strengthening the skin's natural protective barrier.

functionCards.name: Niacinamide (vitamin B3)
functionCards.description: Helps regulate sebum production, refines the appearance of pores, supports skin barrier function and contributes to a more even skin tone.

functionCards.name: Aloe Vera extract
functionCards.description: A soothing and hydrating plant extract that supports skin regeneration and reduces the likelihood of irritation.

functionCards.name: SyriCalm
functionCards.description: An innovative plant-based soothing complex that helps reduce redness, supports the natural balance of sensitive skin and enhances comfort.

faq.question: How do I use PREP FOAM?
faq.answer: Apply the foam directly to the skin or spread it evenly over the face, neck and décolleté with a cosmetic cotton pad. Gently massage it in, then leave it on the skin. No rinsing required. Size: 150 ml.

faq.question: When is it used – before a professional treatment or at home too?
faq.answer: It can be used as a skin preparation step before professional treatments, as well as part of a daily home skincare routine, both morning and evening.

faq.question: Which treatments do we recommend it for?
faq.answer: For preparing Carbon Peeling treatments, before cold plasma treatments, before using the Biopen Nano module, and for preparing microneedling RF treatments on oily and problematic skin.

faq.question: Which skin types is it recommended for?
faq.answer: For oily skin, combination skin, problematic skin, acne-prone skin, large-pored skin, dull skin and mildly sensitive skin.

faq.question: What are its uses?
faq.answer: Professional skin preparation, before Carbon Peeling treatments, before cold plasma treatments, before Biopen Nano treatments, before microneedling RF treatments, as part of pore-cleansing treatments, for sebum-regulating treatments, daily facial cleansing at home, and as part of professional cosmetic treatment protocols.

faq.question: What active ingredients does the formula contain?
faq.answer: Its innovative formula contains mandelic acid, lactobionic acid, gluconolactone, niacinamide, the SyriCalm soothing complex and Aloe Vera extract, which work together to cleanse the skin, regulate sebum production, gently remove dead skin cells and prepare the skin for professional treatments.
